The model fallback feature (praisonaiui.features.model_fallback) lists the available models and stores an ordered fallback chain that the UI can show and edit. The chain is stored, not applied Nothing in PraisonAIUI reads the chain when it sends a request: the provider still calls the agent's own model, and a failed call is not retried on the next model. The chain is also kept in memory only, so a restart clears it. Use it as a setting your own provider or @aiui.reply callback reads (see below).
The model list comes from litellm.model_list when LiteLLM is installed and has models configured. Otherwise it is a short static list: gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, claude-3-5-sonnet and gemini-2.0-flash.
Use the server's shared manager, not a new ModelFallbackManager(), so you see what the API set:
Endpoint Method Description /api/models GET Available models and the current fallback chain /api/models/fallback PUT Set the chain ({"models": [...]}; 400 if not a list)
